topic: Compraventa: qué comprobar antes de entregar una señal
audience: Personas adultas que compran vivienda en Córdoba y Andalucía, información general sin sustituir consejo jurídico
legal_scope: Checklist orientativo sujeto a documentación real, verificación registral y asesoramiento profesional; no inventar plazos ni garantías legales
creative_strategy: 6 unique photographic people and scenes, orange premium surreal world, no logos/text from AI, one short hook per social slide

panels.human_action: discussing a possible housing purchase with a trusted adviser
panels.scene_context: sunny patio table in Córdoba with olive greenery and contemporary ceramics
panels.surreal_symbolism: a glowing translucent orange miniature house gently suspended inside a brass key ring
panels.educational_focus: consider what must be checked before committing a deposit

panels.human_action: examining a realistic handcrafted wooden residential model

panels.surreal_symbolism: a bright amber glass house sculpture emerging from balanced brass hoops
